name: InterContinental Bangkok
insider_take: This luxury tower stands as Bangkok's original skyscraper hotel, where East meets West in sophisticated harmony above the bustling streets of Ploenchit.
whats_special: The InterContinental Bangkok made history as the city's first high-rise hotel when it opened in 1966, pioneering luxury hospitality in Thailand's capital. Its prime Ploenchit location sits directly above the Chit Lom BTS station, offering unparalleled access to shopping meccas like CentralWorld and Erawan Shrine. The hotel's Three Sixty Lounge on the 37th floor provides breathtaking panoramic views of the sprawling metropolis below.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Erawan Shrine to witness the fascinating daily ritual ceremonies from your window, especially beautiful at sunset when the golden spires glow against Bangkok's skyline.
dont_miss: The legendary Erawan Shrine sits directly across the street – this four-faced Hindu shrine is considered one of Bangkok's most sacred sites and draws devotees 24/7. The hotel's rooftop offers front-row seats to the Grand Hyatt's famous New Year's Eve fireworks display, and you're just steps from the world's largest shopping complex, CentralWorld.
pros: Prime central Bangkok location with easy access to shopping and business districts
Exceptional service standards and luxurious accommodations
Multiple award-winning dining venues and rooftop experiences
Comprehensive business and meeting facilities for corporate travelers
cons: Busy urban location with typical city noise levels
